name: epiverse-trace/epidemics
what_it_is: An R package providing a library of published deterministic and stochastic compartmental epidemic models, with modular classes for population demographic structure, non-pharmaceutical interventions, and vaccination regimes to compose and compare epidemic scenarios.
components: population() class for demographic structure and contact matrix
intervention() class for contacts or rate interventions
vaccination() class for group-specific vaccination regimes
measurement: Compartment counts over time (S, E, I, R, V per group)
constraints: Directly transmitted infections only; no vector-borne diseases
R package with C++ backend; requires RTools on Windows
Models parameterised for specific diseases, not general-purpose ODE solvers
notable_absences: No data ingestion from surveillance feeds
